name: zhud_objective_set_visible_and_reset_meter_fill
description: HudUiMgrObjective::SetVisibleAndResetMeterFill toggles the objective label and meter visibility and, when showing, restarts the meter fill animation from the meter bottom.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent HudUiMgr objective-panel cluster because this helper depends on virtual SetVisible dispatch and HUD meter layout.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x411760 validates virtual SetVisible calls for g_HudUiMgrObjectiveLabelTextPanel and g_HudUiMgrObjectiveMeter, the visible-zero early return, resetting g_HudUiMgrObjectiveMeterFillAnimTimerSec to 0, setting g_HudUiMgrObjectiveMeterFillAnimEnabled to 1, truncating meter point[1].y through _ftol, and copying that top value to points[0].y and points[3].y.

The native HudSensorTracker objective panel visible smoke exercises the dependent SetObjectivePanelVisible show/hide paths that call HudUiMgrObjective::SetVisibleAndResetMeterFill through the objective HUD flow.
